items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: you never heard of him, of the name Earvin(?) Davis... I ain't heard of him in years and years. I don't know whether he's still living or not.

ctx.x: Yeah, out West. And each musician, like that tenor player around here, you never heard of him, of the name Earvin(?) Davis. He played a devil of a lot of tenor. But he wouldn't go East. He went to California. I ain't heard of him in years and years. I don't know whether he's still living or not. But anyway, everybody had a different style. And he didn't try to copy up to the other fellows.
Almost all of those musicians in New York, especially those arrangers, they all tried to arrange alike. In other words, they copied on arrangements and arranged alike. Fletcher Henderson
